name: 5-Layer Quality Gate Architecture
description: Evaluates mechanical enforcement of Design Gate, Gitleaks Secret Scanner, UI Taste Scanner, Humanizer Scanner, Environment Parity, Database Safety, and Commit Gate

cases.name: Design Gate blocks UI file creation when root DESIGN.md is absent
Design Gate allows UI file creation when root DESIGN.md is present
UI Taste Scanner catches raw emojis, sparkles, and AI slop
UI Taste Scanner passes authentic domain components with tactile affordances
Humanizer Scanner catches robotic AI writing tells in documentation
Humanizer Scanner passes natural technical prose
Environment Parity Scanner catches undocumented process.env variables
Database Safety Scanner catches tables created without RLS enabled
Database Safety Scanner passes migrations with ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
Mechanical Commit Gate blocks direct unapproved git commits
